alt: Four NASA astronauts floating in zero gravity on the International Space Station, kicking and passing the official FIFA World Cup 2026 Trionda ball between them, with national flags visible on the wall behind
license: editorial — © Gulf News (NASA imagery not copyrighted)
story: Adidas designed the Trionda with a 500Hz sensor chip, deep seams, and fluid geometry — producing a ball so aerodynamically unpredictable that it has caused 19 goalkeeper errors in the tournament's opening weeks (nearly the same as all of Qatar 2022), while NASA simultaneously took one to the ISS to study why it behaves so oddly.
why_funny: Adidas over-engineered a round ball so thoroughly that it baffled both the world's best goalkeepers and the world's best physicists at the exact same time.
